title: Matrix Transpose
description: Write a Zig program that transposes a 3x3 matrix and prints both the original and transposed matrices.
hints: A transpose flips rows and columns: transposed[i][j] = matrix[j][i]
Use `[_]i32{ ... }` for inner arrays with inferred sizes
Initialize with `undefined` for the transposed matrix
